title: SIMATIC S7-300 / S7-400 (legacy)
summary: The previous Siemens generation engineered with STEP 7 Classic (or TIA Portal for S7-300/400 in later versions). Still common in existing plants.

sections.heading: Why it still matters
sections.body: Many installed machines run S7-300 or S7-400 CPUs. Programs often use STL (statement list) and absolute addressing (`I 0.0`, `Q 4.0`, `DB10.DBW2`). Migration to S7-1500 is a frequent project.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: Covered as background knowledge only. **CONCEPTUAL**: no simulation profile.
